sources.citation_or_service: Shinde, V., T. Osada, A. Uesugi and M. Kumar 2008. A report on excavations at Farmana 2007-08 (Excavations at Farmana 2007-08), Deccan College and RIHN. Figure 19, 'Farmana: Plan of Structure Complex nos. 2-4 in Trench 3' (drawing titled 'Farmana Excavation 2007-08: Main Trenches: Plan of Structures and Features').
sources.locator: Figure 19, printed page 25 (PDF page index 36 of the Internet Archive item farmanaexcavationreport200708vasantshindeetal_254_F)

north_arrow_measurement.description: Four-pointed star lettered N, about 102 px from the south to the north point at 300 dpi. The figure is vector graphics, so we took the tips from the PDF's path coordinates (north point 485.20, 506.06 pt; south point 485.31, 530.65 pt), converted to 300 dpi pixels. The star is turned 0.25 deg anticlockwise from the plan's printed site grid, whose lines are exactly square to the page; its east and west points give the same rotation.

rendering_check.note: A vector drawing rendered from the PDF at 300 dpi, so there is no scan distortion; the site grid lines are square to the page within 0.06 deg. We measured on a mask of the coloured wall fills derived from the 300 dpi render (renders/farmana_p0036_300dpi_wallmask.png from renders/farmana_p0036_300dpi.png), fitting the Canny edges of each wall face.

sources.notes: Walls are drawn as coloured fills with brick outlines (orange Complex 3, green Complex 4, blue Complex 2). The trench grid labels (1A1-1H7) mark 10 m squares.

main_system_reason: Main Street, both lanes and most of the walls of all three structure complexes share this direction, which is square within about one degree; the second group is confined to some rooms of Complex 3.
notes: We measured the plan of Structure Complexes 2-4 in the main trenches at Farmana from the 2007-08 excavation report (Figure 19). It is a vector drawing with a printed 10 m site grid, a scale bar and a north star lettered N, so the rendering adds no distortion. The site grid is square to the page and the star is turned a quarter of a degree from it. The houses and lanes are laid out obliquely, about twenty-three degrees anticlockwise from the plan's north. A second group of walls in Complex 3, around rooms 3I, 3L, 3M and 3T and the west wall of the Central Courtyard, runs about six degrees clockwise of the main alignment and is reported separately. Wall faces were fitted to the edges of the coloured wall fills.
